Nikhil (sales): Heads-up — starting a POC with BeaconHealth. They want a 12‑month reserved + burst option, SOC2 evidence, and help debugging Python SDK streaming disconnects behind their corporate gateway. Can we spin up a quick triage?
Sasha (AE): I'll own the pricing. They asked for a baseline and a discount ladder based on commit. Need engineering notes for the quote.
Omar (solutions): For capacity planning: they expect ~30 RPS steady, mostly streaming, peak 80 RPS. Recommend Dedicated with 1.5 node equivalent; I'll put numbers in the draft.
Nikhil (sales): Also they worry about key rotation and whether HSM-backed keys will disrupt long streams.
Lina (eng): HSM/key rotation: control plane rotates keys; active streaming sessions use short-lived session tokens so rotation doesn't interrupt existing streams. Not likely the root cause. What's the failure?
Marta (customer eng): Repro: client (Python SDK v2.0.1) opens stream, yields partial chunks, then client hits `ECONNRESET` after ~12s. Beagle gateway logs show `upstream prematurely closed connection`.
Lina (eng): 12s smells like the gateway's `connection_idle` setting. Our default socket/read timeout in Python SDK is 30s. If the gateway is shorter, it will drop the TCP connection.
Lina (eng): Quick mitigation (Python SDK): enable keepalive and reduce chunk interval so network traffic occurs frequently. Example snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(timeout_ms=60000, stream_chunk_interval_ms=8000, http_keepalive=True)
```
Sasha (AE): Can we provide that snippet and a short rationale for the customer to try now? I'll ask them to run a small smoke test.
Lina (eng): Yes. Also ask for raw `tcpdump` (20s window) and the gateway `access.log` lines around the stream. We need to confirm whether the gateway is terminating idle connections or doing deep packet inspection.
Diego (security): On SOC2 / questionnaire: we can share SOC2 Type II and a short attestation about HSM usage. They want SSO metadata too — send SP metadata and we'll test SAML in staging. For Private installs we require signed CSA and IP allowlist.
Nikhil (sales): I'll attach the questionnaire PDF. Any sensitive docs need redaction?
Diego (security): Only redact customer PII from logs. I'll generate a signed link to the cert bundle (secure.redwood/sso/evidence/beacon).
infra-bot: Quote Q-11002 prepared for "BeaconHealth - 12mo Reserved + Burst" (owner: Sasha).
Omar (solutions): Perf notes for the quote: avg response tokens 200, streaming keeps KV cache warm -> assume 1.8M tokens/day. Plan includes autoscale to add an extra node at 60 RPS sustained. Add fallback policy to route to hosted smaller model at overload.
Marta (customer eng): Customer uploaded logs: 
```
2026-03-22T09:03:11Z stream_id=abc status=200 chunk=1
2026-03-22T09:03:23Z stream_id=abc err=ECONNRESET remote_ip=172.16.5.10
```
Lina (eng): 12s gap again. If they can't reconfigure gateway, set `stream_chunk_interval_ms` to 6-8s and `timeout_ms` > gateway timeout. Also enable HTTP header `Connection: keep-alive` explicitly.
Lina (eng): If gateway strips chunked encoding we can fallback to polling (not ideal) or server-side ping frames. Server ping requires a runtime toggle; I can open a small canary if they need it for the POC.
Sasha (AE): Pricing draft in 90 minutes. Confirm HSM uplift percentage?
Omar (solutions): HSM + VPC = +22% total uplift in our standard template for enterprise private. I'll add line items for eval credits and setup.
Diego (security): For the SAML test: ask them to provide SP metadata (ACS URL, entity id). I will set up a test and share metadata from our IdP.
Marta (customer eng): Customer tried the keep-alive + shorter chunk interval; initial smoke saw streams last 4x longer. They will run a load run tomorrow and send results.
Lina (eng): Good progress. If the issue resurfaces under load, capture a full `strace` on the client and TCP resets on the gateway. We may need to recommend a proxy policy change (increase idle timeout) for production.
Nikhil (sales): Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate action items, attach the questionnaire, and follow up on SP metadata.
Sasha (AE): Thanks team :raised_hands:
Diego (security): I'll provision the secure link and ACL; will ping when ready.
infra-bot: Support ticket #SUP-11321 created and linked to quote Q-11002."
